events.event_name: CHANEL Coco Mademoiselle Crush Absolu Event
events.what_it_is: A café-inspired fragrance experience for Coco Mademoiselle Crush Absolu with personalized fragrance discovery, the wider Coco Mademoiselle line, hair/body products and Chanel makeup.
events.what_is_free: Admission and the fragrance/beauty discovery experience are free; products are available for purchase.
events.caveats: CHANEL says appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged. An appointment is not established as an admission requirement.
events.practical_notes: Second/final public weekend: Sept. 18 noon–7 PM; Sept. 19–20 10 AM–7 PM at 873 Washington Street.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A Japanese-wellness themed Apothékary takeover at SUKOSHI with tongue readings, ingredient education, tincture sampling and kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: Tincture sampling and kakigori while supplies last; first 50 guests in line each day receive a free mini Apothékary tincture.
events.caveats: Free RSVP is advertised by current event listings. Free minis are limited to the first 50 guests each day; kakigori and other samples are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18: 1–9 PM. Saturday–Sunday Sept. 19–20: 9 AM–9 PM.

events.what_it_is: Three-day SACHEU beauty pop-up with immersive activations, product consultations, games, prizes and new launches.
events.what_is_free: Event entry; full-size product for attendees while supplies last, plus games/prizes. Additional gifts may have purchase/receipt conditions.
events.caveats: RSVP does not guarantee entry. Current event information says admission is first come, first served and subject to venue capacity. Free products/prizes are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 11 AM–5 PM daily at 541 W 25th St.

events.address: Chelsea Triangle, West 14th Street & 9th Avenue, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: One-day KILIAN PARIS pop-up celebrating the new Cocktails Collection.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples while supplies last; gifts with purchase are separate.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Complimentary items are while supplies last. Exclusive gifts require purchase and are not represented as free admission benefits.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18 only, noon–8 PM at Chelsea Triangle / W 14th St & 9th Ave.

events.address: Pier 17, 89 South Street, New York, NY 10038
events.what_it_is: Dunkin’ Refresher Truck stop at Pier 17 serving drink samples and swag.
events.what_is_free: Samples of Iced Pumpkin Latte, Berry Clementine Refresher and Strawberry Dragon Fruit Refresher, plus Dunkin’ swag, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Open to the public; samples and swag are while supplies last.

events.address: Pura Vida Nolita, 98 Kenmare Street, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: Two-day Brown Bee activation at Pura Vida Nolita pairing skincare/product giveaways with PB smoothies.
events.what_is_free: For the first 100 guests: a PB smoothie, a full-size Brown Bee product and an exclusive Brown Bee gift.
events.caveats: Open to the public. Giveaway is limited to the first 100 guests; later visitors should not expect the advertised free bundle.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–19, 10 AM–6 PM daily at 98 Kenmare St.
